notes.title: update thing.
notes.notes:
I fired them because I had been unable to contact the programmer Planner Illustrator for a long time(over about 7months). I did not want to change the staff as much as possible, but because I couldn't get in touch with them too long, I decided that I would not be able to update even if I waited any longer, so I decided to change the staff. 
We are now working on updating our staff to create updates. I'm sorry to have kept you waiting, but please give me some time.We will always update Chapter 2.We are currently reviewing the program. In time, the program will be improved and updated by April. We want to add a level-up system at least in battle.

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30440463/769d5fe1b50c3ed94fe13d9529aea7c27d192978.jpg[/img]

ːhuusuishizukuː Shizu​ Live~！Welcome to the live show of Shizuku!

ːhuusuishizukuː Hmhm, it was quick, Huusuienbu has been released for 2 weeks already.

ːhuusuiyamaː Yep, time flies by and we're all getting old.

ːhuusuishizukuː Hey don't say like that Yamaarashi-san, we are still young.

ːhuusuiyamaː That was kidding. Oh by the way, we've got many suggestions
 on improving this game these days.

ːhuusuishizukuː That is why we hurried to make an update.

ːhuusuiyamaː Eh... So could you tell us what we suggestion have received and  what we are going to update?

ːhuusuishizukuː Wait a sec and let me see... Yep, Player A said "Thumb down, girls wear too many"... is that asking us to dress up more like... in summer?

ːhuusuiyamaː This is kind of... well director, will you cut this part? What? It is a LIVE show ???

ːhuusuishizukuː Player B ask for my Doujinshi... what is a Doujinshi anyway?

ːhuusuiyamaː Well I think that is some sort of album of cute girl... so could we go back and tell something about the game itself?

ːhuusuishizukuː Ok... some players said it sometimes stops response. The developing team think it was something about displaying optmization and made some fixes, hope it'll work.

ːhuusuiyamaː And enemy will not camp on the dead players anymore.

ːhuusuishizukuː Summon tower can set up a rally point now, and guading area of close combat units are fixed.

ːhuusuiyamaː And many detailed fixes, character walking sprites, minimaps,
 things on the maps, some skill and buff icons and so on... Oh, sometimes
 a Huusuisi can't summon tower is due to lack of Maximum Huusui Power (MaxFP), players can see hint of this now when encountered with such situations.

ːhuusuishizukuː And some mispelling... Eh? There is a update of Yamaarashi's photo when still a little girl !

ːhuusuiyamaː Hey stop it, this is a kind of humiliation!

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30440463/5d907a3864aaab8a4c4f73bd3f659d44374e652b.jpg[/img]

ːhuusuishizukuː No ! Nononono ! Crying Yamaarashi is just as cute ! Those
 Lolicons will burst into roar when see this !

ːhuusuiyamaː Oh god just leave it...

ːhuusuishizukuː You are cute Yamaarashi-san ! If there was a Doujinshi, it must have been you featuring !

ːhuusuiyamaː I hope not.... Shizuku, how about we go back and talk about the battle changing... Players say that Mission 37 and 38 is just too hard so we make it easier.

ːhuusuishizukuː It is Uncle Hichou and your mission! I'll help though can't go to the battlefield !

ːhuusuiyamaː Nice of you, Shizuku.

ːhuusuishizukuː So update today is like that, the next update is around Sep.25th which will add toturial and more challege missions! 

ːhuusuiyamaː I am looking forward to it now.

ːhuusuishizukuː So this is the end of today's Shizu Live. Thank you for watching !

ːhuusuishizukuː ːhuusuiyamaː ：See you next show!
